name: Oddworld: New 'n' Tasty - Deluxe Edition
storyline: Abe is a Mudokon who works as a first class Floor-Waxer at RuptureFarms, a sprawling meatpacking empire. One late night he overhears his boss, Molluck the Glukkon, plotting to turn Abe and his fellow Mudokons into the company's next product, Tasty Treats, in a desperate effort to rescue the failing business. Thrust into a life of unexpected adventure, Abe must escape the dark recesses of RuptureFarms and the desolate, dangerous surroundings beyond it, all while trying to save thousands of his fellow Mudokons from the same grim fate.
summary: Includes the main 'Oddworld: New 'n' Tasty' game, the 'Alf's Escape' DLC and the 'Scrub Abe' costume DLC. Abe, the original Oddworld hero, faces ancient ruins, dodge carnivorous beasts and trigger-happy hunting parties in this lovingly recrafted take on classic Abe's Oddysee. Built from the ground up, get breathtaking visuals, enhanced audio and improved gameplay with New 'n' Tasty - the original Oddworld game using the latest next-gen technology.
